name: form
useFor: Use for a form with validation managed by react-hook-form: wrap it in Form, render each field with FormField, and place FormLabel, FormControl (around one control), FormDescription and FormMessage inside a FormItem. For a single field without react-hook-form, use Field.
constraints: Validating on every keystroke before the first submit
title: Form
description: react-hook-form fields laid out as the brand's get-started form: display labels, square fields, red messages.
